responsibility: This file is GCC’s main RTL simplification and canonicalization implementation. It contains the folding logic that recognizes constant and algebraic identities over RTX expressions, rewrites binary and unary operations into simpler or canonical forms, interprets mode-specific bit properties and constant-pool references, and supports simplification of subregs, vector constants, and polymorphic integer RTX values. It also houses extensive checking-build selftests for scalar, vector, and CONST_POLY_INT simplifications. Its responsibility is the core reusable RTL fold engine consumed throughout expansion, combine, and later RTL optimization passes.
